name: AI Systems
purpose: Systems whose behaviour depends on AI models at run time: LLM features, retrieval, agents and model-driven workflows. Adds model integration and context management, evaluation and observability, and AI-specific safety and data governance.
use_when: Users get output that a model produces at run time, or a model decides what the system does next.
Output quality cannot be proven by ordinary tests alone and has to be measured.
User or company data is sent to a model, or retrieved to ground its answers.
not_when: AI was only used to write the code or the content. That is a way of working, not a system responsibility.
A model is called once at build time and its output is reviewed and committed like any other content.
An AI SDK is installed. Technology alone never activates a profile.

documents.when: The system retrieves documents or records to ground model output: search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or long-term memory.

checks.name: AI evaluation
checks.what: The evaluation suite in EVALUATION.md runs and meets its thresholds before a model, prompt or retrieval change ships.

checks.name: AI safety tests
checks.what: Adversarial cases from SAFETY.md, including prompt injection and data leakage, run and pass.
